seed_sequence: [20261113, arm, p, k, batch] integers only. arm 1=INTERP, 2=FOURIER, 3=random, 4=perturb sigma 0.02, 5=perturb sigma 0.1.
dominance: E_q < E_b - tau AND F_q > F_b + tau on the energy-selected states
budget_formula: Bp = max(4*Rp, C_family_upper); new_work = max(0, Bp - existing). For p9-12, Rp is the round4_V nfev_sum and existing is that floor plus this branch's round4 n_eval plus round5 n_eval_new. For p6 and p7 there is no 256-start V row, so Rp = existing = round4 n_eval + round5 n_eval_new. C_family_upper is 53927.
interp_source: stored round4_N QAOA schedule at p-1, resampled on layer-center knots with constant endpoint clamp
perturb_source: stored energy-selected QAOA vector at the same p, labeled separately from random starts
p13: only if every priority slice finishes under its new_work cap
